The vendor directly operating and providing **Coolors** at **coolors.co** is **Coolors s.r.l.** (created and developed by Fabrizio Bianchi).

### Evidence & Provider Statements
* **Terms of Service** (`coolors.co`):
  > *"Coolors s.r.l. Viale G. Ribotta, 21. Roma - Italia. Owner contact email: info@coolors.co. 'Coolors' refers to: this website, including its subdomains and any other website through which the Owner makes its Service available..."*
* **Privacy Policy** (`coolors.co`):
  > *"Owner and Data Controller: Coolors s.r.l. Piazza Roberto Gaucci, 23. Colleferro - 00034 - Roma - Italia."*
* **Website / App Store Listings**:
  > The website footer notes *"© Coolors by Fabrizio Bianchi"*, and the official application listing lists the developer as **Coolors srl**.
